Title: No proxies but no print version?

Messages.Author: nedleeds
Messages.Body: If an event is marked no proxy can a player proxy Baba Yaga (or use the drivethru community card)?

Messages.Author: kschaefer
Messages.Body:
www.vekn.net/tournament-rules/4-tournament-game-rules

It is not a proxy. Cards from the VEKN expansions are legal for all events even if they are printed.

The fact that proxy cards have similar requirements has caused confusion before, but these cards are not proxies.

My original question was more confusion around a no proxy event and the interaction with cards that have no official printing. I guess as a follow up, are the Baba Yagas via drive-thru not legal at say nationals but an ink jet are?

Messages.Author: self biased
Messages.Body:
strictly speaking, yes. However the Tournament Organizer can choose to allow them.

The TO in a regional tournament allowed me to play with the first generation of Amaranth proxies so that Ke could get some feedback, so there's no harm in asking.

Hey sorry for necro-ing the thread but I have a stupid question.

Suppose I am using a printed card from a PDF set in an event that does NOT allow proxies (which as discussed, I can, as printout from PDF set are not considered proxies… yet).

Must I then print the card from the original PDF sets in that case? Even when the text would be functionally different (e.g. Public Vilification, Inside Dirt) and could cause confusion? Or can I print a, well, “proxy” with the most recent text? Thanks!
